model_annotation: Figure 6 illustrates the training rewards of LLaMA-3.1-8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displaying data for both on-policy and LUFFY training methodologies. The x-axis is labeled “Steps”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 500, and features tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0.0 to 0.2, and features tick labels at intervals of 0.05.  A blue solid line represents “LLama-On-Policy-Easy”, starting at approximately 0.04 at step 0 and ending at approximately 0.16 at step 500, with a generally increasing trend and minor fluctuations. A red solid line represents “LLama-LUFFY-Easy”, beginning at approximately 0.04 at step 0 and concluding at approximately 0.18 at step 500, also exhibiting a generally increasing trend with minor fluctuations. A blue dashed line represents “LLama-On-Policy-Hard”, starting at approximately 0.02 at step 0 and ending at approximately 0.06 at step 500, showing a gradual increase. Finally, a red dashed line represents “LLama-LUFFY-Hard”, beginning at approximately 0.02 at step 0 and ending at approximately 0.12 at step 500, demonstrating a generally increasing trend.
